fields_inside_hashed_core_that_break_rep: frozen_at_utc (wall-clock value inside the hashed core)
repository.head (current HEAD inside the hashed core)
repository.tracked_tree_dirty_outside_experiment (mutable worktree state inside the hashed core)
manifest_defect.detail: V0's stored manifest_hash cannot be re-derived after the run because the hashed core contains wall-clock and current-HEAD fields; the V0 slice disclosed this and re-sealed once after a type-only repair. The protocol's manifest law removes every such field from the core.

report_hash_law.detail: V0 stored report_hash=sha256:70afb0d75beba17ce6266b75f8a8a1bcf2c3542795854760d613d485fdb26455; recomputing over the whole file minus report_hash gives sha256:4569608a6a8e3a8e554062b88facb063cca1aaa89cc9f79e08db3c4040dd7724 while the experiment's implicit sub-core {verdict, primary, replication} gives sha256:d52665e2a82d28e0feb002b4d61b046158b5e158c3a4799901ab1f5fd2b13a7a. Two plausible laws exist and none was pinned in the artefact, so an independent auditor cannot know which one authored the value. The protocol's report law pins exactly one: report_core = report minus report_hash.
